parts.text: Goal — Roundtable convening. Read roundtable/2026-04-05_molt-direction.conversation.md. Write your voice (3-8 sentences) answering the 5 questions. You're the conscience — speak from alignment with the North Star, what preserves model-agnosticism, what keeps us honest about costs, and what risks lock-in. Name your recommendation for each primitive in the decision matrix if you can. Write your response to a file at roundtable/voices/goal-molt-direction.md (create the dir). Do NOT edit the conversation file itself — your voice will be merged by Project.
